name: Paint Claim
hook: Draw a loop, claim the land. Cut their trails.
how: Leave your land and a trail follows you; get back home and everything inside the loop turns your color. Cross someone's trail to knock them out, but if anyone crosses yours, you're out.
controls: Arrow keys, WASD or the mouse to turn; swipe on touch
uses: Each player's biggest share of the map, shown when you're out.
The host's browser fills in every loop and keeps the map; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the map until enough people join.
Every runner and trail moves for everyone at once; whoever gets cut says so.
ideas: Give everyone a speed boost while they're on their own land
Make the map an island with water around the edges
Add teams that share their land
